findings.currentPlan: Omgevingsplan Haarlemmermeer CVDR696552 remains controlling address source.
findings.splitting: Municipality publishes current criteria: original dwelling at least 120 m2; maximum 3 resulting dwellings; Bbl minimum/new-build area requirements; parking and traffic capacity; no LIB 3; no bedrijfswoning; housing-stock/liveability, image-quality and green-space tests; monuments only exceptionally for preservation. Outside built-up area parking must be entirely on own land and access must suit multiple households.
findings.route: Vergunningcheck and Regels op de kaart first. If the plan conflicts with the plan, omgevingsvergunning for deviation is needed. 'Verken uw idee' and concept application are available before final filing.
findings.documents: Omgevingsloket produces the exact checklist. Municipality gives common examples: existing/proposed floor plans, elevations and sections; construction-technical information; materials/colours. A parking study is expressly required where own-site parking is insufficient. Participation report should be submitted.
findings.fees: Legesverordening Haarlemmermeer 2026 is current; exact permit cost depends on activity combination. Concept costs are credited when final application follows within one year after advice.
findings.opkoop: Current Huisvestingsverordening 2022 as amended remains valid until a new regulation or 16-01-2027; opkoopbescherming remains active and 2026 programme says it continues for now.
